While children around the world return to school, Gaza’s children are entering their third consecutive year without an education. More than 90% of schools in Gaza have been damaged or reduced to ruins amid Israel’s unrelenting genocide. 22,000+ Palestinian children slaughtered. 44,000+ injured. Thousands remain missing. Likely martyred and still beneath the rubble. While children elsewhere put on new uniforms, carry new school bags and look forward to seeing their friends, children in Gaza are fighting simply to survive. Children are deliberately sniped as target practice and killed including for flying kites. Childhood stolen. Thousands orphaned. Children have been forced into the role of parents, caring for younger siblings after their parents martyred. The suffering doesn't stop at Gaza. In the West Bank, 84 Palestinian schools currently face demolition or orders to stop educating, leaving almost 13,000 students uncertain whether their schools will exist tomorrow. All of this unfolding against the backdrop of Israel’s continuing occupation and expansion of illegal settlements. For Palestinian children, school should mean learning, not survival. Childhood should mean safety, not fear. Three years of genocide. 78 years of occupation. And it continues. For Palestinians, the genocide that began after October 7 never paused. There has been no ceasefire from hunger, deprivation, displacement, or grief. Only different forms of violence. Three grueling years of destroying homes, taking lives, and trying to erase hope. Children still wake up hungry. Elders long to return to their land. Young people cannot provide for their families. Babies die from malnutrition before they have a chance to live. And for three years, the world has watched. The Sameer Project provides food, water, medical care, shelter, and the support people need to keep going. To live with dignity. To hold onto hope. To build a future in their own homeland. Our work is rooted in Palestinian freedom and self-determination. Our people deserve to live long enough to see liberation. To see the occupation end. Keep showing up. Donate through the links in our bio. Help us turn your solidarity into the essentials our people need today - to sustain their hope for tomorrow.

Sad🇵🇸💔|| Palestine, officially known as the State of Palestine, is a country in the Middle East located along the eastern Mediterranean. It consists of the West Bank, including East Jerusalem, and the Gaza Strip. Palestine is a land of immense historical, cultural, and religious importance, with a history stretching back thousands of years. Palestine is home to some of the world’s most historically significant cities and sites. Jerusalem is one of the holiest cities in the world and is sacred to Muslims, Christians, and Jews. Bethlehem is traditionally regarded as the birthplace of Jesus Christ, while Jericho is among the world’s oldest continuously inhabited cities. Modern Palestinian national identity developed over many generations and became especially prominent during the 19th and 20th centuries. The Palestinian Declaration of Independence was proclaimed in 1988, and in 2012 the United Nations granted Palestine non-member observer State status. Today, most UN member states recognize the State of Palestine. Palestinian culture is rich in traditions including Arabic language and literature, tatreez embroidery, dabke dancing, olive cultivation, traditional cuisine, and strong family and community ties. Despite decades of conflict, displacement, and political division, Palestinians maintain a strong connection to their homeland and a distinct national identity. #palestine #israel #map #maps #fyp
